# Stress and Coping — Fall 2026

## Week 3: Stress and the HPA Axis

This week covers the physiological stress response. We will discuss the
[[HPA axis]] in detail, including cortisol release and negative feedback.
The Amygdala plays a central role in threat detection, and we will connect
this to Allostatic Load across chronic stress exposure.

Students will explain the role of the HPA axis in the physiological stress
response.

Students will describe how chronic activation leads to allostatic load.

## Week 4: Coping Styles

An overview of problem-focused and emotion-focused coping strategies.
